coupling_convention: dimensionless kinetic mixing χ (fixed polarisation scenario)
notes: ORGAN Phase 1a placed limits on dark photon kinetic mixing χ in the 63.2–67.1 µeV mass range. The primary axion-photon limit |g_aγγ| ≤ 3×10^-12 was rescaled to dark photon limits using Eq. (7) with B₀ = 11.5 T and fixed polarisation scenario (|cos θ| ≈ √0.03). The paper also reports limits on scalar/dilaton dark matter (g_φγγ) and QEMD axion couplings (g_aAB), but the dark photon limits are the most stringent in this mass region. Data points extracted from the mass range 63.2–67.1 µeV (converted to eV) with coupling derived from the rescaling formula. The paper states these are 'the most sensitive to date in some regions of the parameter space' for dark photons. Random polarisation scenario would yield χ ≈ 1.0e-13 (less conservative). | selector: text over figure_vision (quality (1, 1, 1, 1, 3, 0, 0.85, 7))
